name: Ink & Bone
description: Design tokens for the PureLand research-program prototype and forkable toolbox.

ink.role: Warm near-black. Primary ground in dark contexts, primary text on bone.

bone.role: Warm parchment cream. Primary ground in light contexts, primary text on ink.

brass.role: Contemplative accent. Display headings, key rules. Accent only, not body text.

oxblood.role: The extraction register. Warnings, costs, the three poisons, strikethrough color. Short emphasis only.

celadon.role: The return register. Growth, reciprocity, learning that travels back. Accent only, not body text.

rule.role: Hairline rules. Graphite on a light ground; lightened toward bone on a dark one, where plain graphite fails contrast.

drawDuration.role: An event stroke lays down at a hand's pace.

drawStagger.role: Strokes arrive in order, not at once.

easeSettle.role: Ink moves and then settles, the way a stroke ends.

fadeDuration.role: Secondary marks arrive without their own event.

easeLinked.role: A dial maps position. Easing on a dial misreports the hand.

threadInset.role: The nib: the thread's view-timeline band, a 4vh window on the horizon. Pairs with horizonY.

sceneObserve.role: Held-scene traverse height for Observe. Modest on purpose: extra scroll is manufactured dwell.

sceneTrace.role: Held-scene traverse height for Trace. The scene runs at 641px and up.

horizonY.role: The horizon's height. The thread band and the plate pins derive from it.
